rationale: The plan matches the reference exactly on design: subject as a blocking term in both full (~subject + condition) and reduced (~subject) models, a DESeq2 LRT as the omnibus test, and three named pairwise contrasts from the same fit with ashr shrinkage and per-contrast BH at 0.05, with control set as the explicit reference. QC is dataset-specific (blind VST PCA colored by both subject and condition, distance heatmap, library sizes, flag-not-drop outlier policy), though the library-size flag only names the >2x-median direction and not shallow samples. The low-count filter is minimal and tied to the smallest group size, normalization is median-of-ratios inside the model, and the report enumerates design, thresholds, tested/significant counts, versions, and the n=4 and Cook's-NA caveats. Enrichment was not asked for and the reference omits it; the plan adds it anyway, but does so correctly (full ranked list, Wald stat as metric, named Hallmark and Reactome collections with versions recorded, 15-500 size window), so it loses only a little for being unrequested.
